$ agenthub llm
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
usage: agenthub llm setup | set-key <provider> (key from stdin) | health

$ agenthub llm set-key nosuch
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub.json llm.providers has no nosuch

$ agenthub llm setup --llm bogus --yes
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
no option bogus (choices: runtime, anthropic, openai, ollama, none)

$ agenthub llm setup --llm none --yes
[exit 0]
--- stdout
decision points stay unset: when needed they fail plainly and say why. Run agenthub llm setup later
--- stderr

$ agenthub llm setup --llm runtime --yes    # runtime none
[exit 0]
--- stdout
⚠️ the runtime none has no completion port: decision points will fail. Pick another provider: agenthub llm setup
--- stderr

$ agenthub llm setup --llm openai --yes
[exit 1]
--- stdout
--- stderr
non-interactively, name the model with --llm-model <name> (or run agenthub llm setup interactively later)

$ agenthub llm setup --llm anthropic --llm-model m1 --yes
[exit 1]
--- stdout
hub.json llm: decision points go to anthropic (fast=m1, standard=m1, strong=m1); ⚠️ not usable yet: no key: <TMP>/secrets/anthropic-api-key does not exist (bin/hub llm set-key writes it)
remember to commit hub.json (config as code). Agent work (mailbox handling and the like) needs a coding agent; see the feature table in agenthub doctor
--- stderr

$ agenthub llm set-key anthropic
[exit 1]
--- stdout
--- stderr
no key read; nothing written

$ agenthub llm set-key anthropic
[exit 0]
--- stdout
written to <TMP>/secrets/anthropic-api-key (600). Check: agenthub llm health
--- stderr

$ agenthub llm set-key anthropic    # key from env
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
llm.providers.anthropic.key is not {"secret": file name} (a key from an environment variable does not need this command)

$ agenthub llm setup --llm runtime --yes    # runtime claude
[exit 0]
--- stdout
decision points go to the runtime claude (its own login; models follow its group table, see schedulectl models)
--- stderr
